title: Tall, Tall Mountain
coordinateSystem: Y up; source coordinates /100; yaw degrees from +Z toward +X
routeActions: Cross the entrance stream and follow the supported rising trail onto the lower terrace
Jump onto the near end of the braided log; balance along its live centerline as your weight rolls it toward the far bank
Wait near the far end until the log approaches the bank, then jump to the ledge near [43, -15.48, 23]
Jump onto the higher trail and continue around the mountain past the rolling pasta balls
At the broad upper gap, run toward [30, 3.13, 12] from [16, 6.2, 18], then press crouch and jump together
Climb past Fwoosh and the mole ledges, timing jumps across the remaining short breaks
Follow the final ramp to the summit and collect the star already waiting there
